title: Sharing standardized image-derived data in computational pathology using DICOM
abstract: arXiv:2609.14530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Development and evaluation of computational pathology methods require access to large and diverse datasets. Over the past decade, various initiatives invested significantly into collecting, centralizing, and sharing pathology imaging data. In contrast, sharing of image-derived data such as region-of-interest delineations or segmentation masks is less well developed. In this work, we describe our approach to encoding and sharing image-derived pathology data in a standardized manner within the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Imaging Data Commons (IDC), a platform that hosts and provides public access to de-identified radiology and pathology data. The IDC relies on the Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) standard for data harmonization, yet the adoption of DICOM for pathology image-derived content has remained largely unexplored until now. translated_title: 使用DICOM在计算病理学中共享标准化的图像衍生数据
translated_abstract: 计算病理学方法的开发和评估需要访问大型且多样化的数据集。在过去十年中，各类倡议投入了大量资源用于收集、集中和共享病理成像数据。相比之下，图像衍生数据（如感兴趣区域描绘或分割掩码）的共享发展则相对滞后。在这项工作中，我们描述了在美国国家癌症研究所（NCI）影像数据共享平台中，以标准化方式编码和共享图像衍生病理数据的方法。该平台托管并提供去标识化放射学和病理数据的公开访问。该平台依靠医学数字成像和通信（DICOM）标准进行数据协调，然而迄今为止，DICOM在病理图像衍生内容方面的应用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们展示了五个通过转换进行协调的代表性数据集。
tldr: 本文提出在美国国家癌症研究所影像数据共享平台中，利用DICOM标准对图像衍生病理数据（如感兴趣区域描绘和分割掩码）进行标准化编码与共享的方法。
